official.deadline_note: The Call is open from March 2nd to 5:00 pm (Lisbon time) March 31st, 2026. A second, separate deadline follows for the host institution: Contracting Institutions had 10 working days to validate applications, from 6 April 2026 (10 AM) to 17 April 2026 (23:59). Applications not validated by the designated Contracting Institution are excluded from the call. FCT states the call 'takes place each year in March or, occasionally, between March and April' but no dates for the next (2027) cycle had been published on the official pages as of 2026-10-10.
official.application_cycle: 2026 cycle. Annual call; FCT states it takes place each year in March or, occasionally, between March and April. No 2027 dates published.
official.status_note: The 2026 cycle closed on 31 March 2026 at 17:00 Lisbon time. Provisional results were published on 31 July 2026, with a preliminary hearing open until 14 August 2026, and final results were expected at the beginning of November 2026. FCT's 'Expected Calls' (Concursos Previstos) page publishes no calls and no date for the next PhD studentship round.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording on the call page (Funding section): 'Selected applicants will receive a monthly allowance, as well as other complementary support in accordance with the amounts set out by the RBI, such as tuition fees, support for additional training activities, presentation of work at scientific meetings, personal accident insurance and, when applicable, travel and relocation costs.' FCT's studentships FAQ publishes the limits: 'O valor da propina/matricula/inscricao/custos de formacao pago pela FCT as universidades portuguesas corresponde ao total de 2.750,00 euros, independentemente dos valores aplicados pelas diferentes instituicoes de ensino superior' (EUR 2,750 fixed total for Portuguese degree-awarding institutions) and 'A FCT paga ate um maximo de 8.000,00 euros de propina por ano no estrangeiro' (up to EUR 8,000 per year abroad). Tuition is paid only to the degree-awarding institution (FAQ Q25/Q31).
benefits: Monthly maintenance allowance (subsidio mensal de manutencao): EUR 1,359.64 per month for a Bolsa de Doutoramento (BD) in Portugal, EUR 2,168.65 per month abroad, values updated with effect from 1 January 2026
Tuition fees (propinas): EUR 2,750 total paid to Portuguese degree-awarding institutions regardless of what they charge; up to EUR 8,000 per year for foreign degree-awarding institutions
Support for additional training activities (apoio a atividades de formacao complementar)
Presentation of work at scientific meetings: one-off EUR 750, awarded automatically with the first monthly maintenance payment
Personal accident insurance (seguro de acidentes pessoais) - provided by the Contracting Institution for contracts under this call
When applicable, travel and relocation costs: one-off travel allowance EUR 300 within Europe / EUR 600 outside Europe, and one-off installation allowance EUR 1,000
eligibility: PhD studentships in the regular line of application are aimed at applicants that are enrolled or that comply with the requirements to enrol in a PhD program to obtain a doctoral degree

Suitable for candidates who want to develop PhD research activities in any academic institution, national or international, including public and private higher education institutions, R&D units, Associated Laboratories, as well as other private non-profit institutions whose main purpose is R&D activities
Portuguese citizens, citizens of EU member states, citizens from third-party states, stateless citizens and citizens beneficiaries of political refugee status are eligible to apply
It is mandatory not to have benefited from any PhD studentship or PhD in Industry studentship directly funded by FCT, regardless of its duration
It is mandatory not to hold a doctoral degree

It is mandatory to live in Portugal on a permanent and habitual basis if applying to a both-in-Portugal-and-abroad or entirely-abroad studentship; this requirement applies to both applicants with Portuguese and foreign citizenship
The remaining admissibility requirements are available in section 4 of the Notice of the Call
requirements: Applications, and the supporting documents listed in the RBI and in the Notice of the Call, must be submitted online using exclusively the available application form at https://myfct.fct.pt, selecting the regular line of application and clicking on 'start application'
Applications or any additional information submitted by any other means will not be accepted
Submit between the opening and closing dates published for the call

Ensure the Contracting Institution indicated in the application form validates the application through the myFCT platform within its 10-working-day window; applications that are not validated will be excluded from this call
Submit proof of recognition of conversion of degrees or diplomas awarded by foreign institutions, where the qualification was awarded abroad (processed on the DGES platform)
Meet the admissibility requirements in section 4 of the Notice of the Call
Functions must be performed under the exclusive dedication regime (regime de dedicacao exclusiva) provided for in Article 5 of the Research Fellowship Holder Statute
documents: The application form submitted through myFCT, with the supporting documents listed in the FCT Regulation for Studentships and Fellowships (RBI) and in the Notice of the Call
CIENCIAVITAE curriculum vitae - the personal CV is evaluated as half of Criterion A and CV questions are directed to the CIENCIAVITAE helpdesk
Work plan (plano de trabalhos), evaluated as Criterion B
Identification of the Contracting Institution that will host and validate the application (Criterion C)
Proof of recognition of conversion of degrees or diplomas awarded by foreign institutions, where the qualification was awarded abroad
Documents listed in the Application Guide, FAQ, Ethics Guide and CIENCIAVITAE Guide published with the call
selection_criteria: All admissible applications must be graded from zero (0.000, minimum) to five (5.000, maximum) in each of the three evaluation criteria, by panels composed of experts with recognized experience and scientific merit (33 panels in the regular line)
Criterion A - Merit of the Applicant, weight 30%, split equally between academic career (50%) and personal CV (50%)
Criterion B - Merit of the Work Plan, weight 40%, assessed qualitatively by the panel with substantiated reasoning
Criterion C - Merit of the Hosting Conditions, weight 30%, assessed qualitatively by the panel
Applications will be ranked according to the weighted average classification of the three criteria
Tie-breakers in order of precedence: criterion B (Merit of the Work Plan), then criterion A (Merit of the Applicant), then criterion C (Merit of the Hosting Conditions)
Applications evaluated with a final classification lower than three values (3,000) are not eligible for granting a studentship
coverage: Monthly maintenance allowance (subsidio mensal de manutencao) of EUR 1,359.64 in Portugal / EUR 2,168.65 abroad for a Bolsa de Doutoramento
Tuition fees, registration and enrolment costs paid to the degree-awarding institution (EUR 2,750 for Portuguese institutions; up to EUR 8,000 per year abroad)
Support for additional training activities (subsidio de formacao complementar, maximum 6 months)
Presentation of work at scientific meetings (one-off EUR 750)
When applicable, one-off travel allowance (EUR 300 Europe / EUR 600 outside Europe) and one-off installation allowance (EUR 1,000, where research work lasts at least six consecutive months)
application_method: Register or sign in at https://myfct.fct.pt
Select the regular line of application and click 'start application'
Complete the application form, indicating the Contracting Institution
Attach the supporting documents listed in the RBI and in the Notice of the Call
Submit before the published closing time (5:00 pm Lisbon time on 31 March 2026)
Ask the Contracting Institution to validate the application through myFCT within its 10-working-day period
Applications for studentships fully abroad continue to be contracted and managed directly by FCT
official.application_route: Apply online only, through the application form at myfct.fct.pt, selecting the regular line of application; anything sent by other means is not accepted.
official.study_mode: Exclusive dedication regime (regime de dedicacao exclusiva) required under Article 5 of the Research Fellowship Holder Statute
official.citizenship_residency: Portuguese citizens, citizens of EU member states, citizens from third-party states, stateless citizens and citizens beneficiaries of political refugee status may apply. Applicants for a both-in-Portugal-and-abroad or entirely-abroad studentship must live in Portugal on a permanent and habitual basis, and this applies regardless of whether the applicant holds Portuguese or foreign citizenship.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - citizens of EU member states, citizens of third-party states, stateless citizens and beneficiaries of political refugee status are all eligible to apply, including for studentships at national or international academic institutions. The one restriction is that mixed or entirely-abroad studentships require permanent and habitual residence in Portugal.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The regular line of application includes all scientific areas and is aimed at research to be carried out in scientific and academic institutions. A separate, specific line of application within the same call targets research work plans carried out for the most part in one or more non-academic institutions; that line has its own page and is not covered by this record.
official.research_requirement: Applicants must be enrolled in, or comply with the requirements to enrol in, a PhD programme leading to a doctoral degree, and must develop research activities leading to that degree in a scientific or academic institution. A work plan is submitted and evaluated as Criterion B (40% of the score).
official.description: To fulfil its aim of promoting a national public policy for advanced training with social relevance and impact, FCT opens an annual Call for granting PhD studentships under the Regulamento de Bolsas de Investigacao da FCT / FCT Regulation for Studentships and Fellowships (RBI) and the Estatuto do Bolseiro de Investigacao / Research Fellowship Holder Statute (EBI). The regular line of application includes all scientific areas and is aimed at research to be carried out in scientific and academic institutions, funding activities that lead to the award of the PhD degree. Selected applicants receive a monthly maintenance allowance plus complementary support such as tuition fees, additional training, presentation of work at scientific meetings, personal accident insurance and, when applicable, travel and relocation costs. For the 2026 cycle FCT published 3,628 applications, 1,000 approved studentships and a total funding value of EUR 90,625,000 in the regular line, a 28% approval rate.
official.region: Portugal (studentships may be based in Portugal, both in Portugal and abroad, or entirely abroad)
official.program_type: National public research funding call for doctoral studentships (Bolsas de Investigacao para Doutoramento), regular line of application

not_confirmed: duration - the maximum length of the studentship in months/years is published only in the Estatuto do Bolseiro de Investigacao (EBI) and the RBI, not on the official call page
english_requirement - no English language requirement (IELTS/TOEFL or medium-of-instruction rule) is published for this call on the official call page or the FCT studentships FAQ
The fully enumerated list of mandatory submission documents - published only in section 4 of the Notice of the Call and in the Application Guide
Dates for the next (2027) cycle - FCT's Expected Calls page publishes none
The exact amount of tuition FCT will pay for a specific foreign institution beyond the EUR 8,000 per year cap
verification.notes: The monthly maintenance allowance for Bolsas de Doutoramento (BD) in Portugal was read as EUR 1,359.64 (EUR 2,168,65 abroad) from FCT's own 2026 values table (Tabela-de-Valores-SMM-2026.pdf, values effective 1 January 2026). Because that PDF has no text layer, the figure was verified three independent ways: Tesseract OCR on 400 DPI page renders across six passes, direct vector-glyph geometry on the PDF content stream, and the year-on-year series (every category rises exactly EUR 50.00 per year, 2024 to 2025 to 2026, matching FCT's published statement that the 2026 update is a flat EUR 50 increase). The third-party figure of EUR 1,686/month circulating for this call is the 2022 Pos-Doutoramento (BPD) value, not the doctoral studentship. Deadline, timeline, eligibility, evaluation criteria, results statistics and the tuition/travel allowance amounts were taken from the official call page, the FCT studentships FAQ and FCT's own news items.

applicant_utility.summary: The FCT doctoral studentship pays a fixed monthly maintenance allowance of EUR 1,359.64 for work based in Portugal (EUR 2,168.65 abroad), with tuition paid directly to the degree-awarding institution, a EUR 750 scientific-meeting payment, personal accident insurance and, for mixed or overseas plans, one-off travel and installation allowances of EUR 300/600 and EUR 1,000. In the 2026 regular line 3,628 applications competed for 1,000 studentships, so even a strong profile faces roughly one-in-four odds and the work plan carries the single largest share of the score at 40%. Because FCT runs this once a year in a narrow March window and publishes no next-cycle dates in advance, missing the deadline costs a full year rather than a few weeks.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Someone already enrolled in, or immediately eligible for, a doctoral programme who has lined up a supervisor and an academic institution willing to act as Contracting Institution and validate the application inside ten working days.
application_readiness_checklist: Get written confirmation from your host institution that it will act as Contracting Institution and can validate the application within the 10-working-day window - unvalidated applications are excluded before evaluation begins
Build the CIENCIAVITAE CV months in advance: half of Criterion A is academic career and half is personal CV, both drawn from that profile

If any qualification was awarded outside Portugal, start the degree-recognition request on the DGES platform well before March - DGES has at least 30 days by law, and in 2026 the platform was down for roughly 15 days during the application window
Work the work plan with your supervisor over several weeks: at 40% of the score it is the heaviest criterion and the first tie-breaker
Check the Notice of the Call, Application Guide, FAQ, Ethics Guide and CIENCIAVITAE Guide on the day the call opens - they carry the definitive document list, not the web summary
Open a Portuguese (PT50) bank account before contracting if you are not already resident in Portugal
common_rejection_risks: Failing to get the named Contracting Institution to validate the application inside its 10-working-day window, which removes the file from the call before any panel sees it
Falling below the 3,000 out of 5.000 threshold, which makes an application ineligible for a studentship no matter where it ranks
A thin or generic hosting arrangement: Criterion C is worth 30% and is assessed qualitatively on the conditions the institution actually offers
Assuming a previous FCT-funded PhD or PhD-in-Industry studentship, however short, is not a bar - it is a hard disqualification regardless of duration
Applying for an entirely-abroad or mixed studentship without permanent and habitual residence in Portugal, which applies equally to Portuguese and foreign nationals
Sending documents, a CV or clarifications by email alongside the form, which FCT explicitly refuses to accept
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition above the FCT caps is the applicant's own cost: EUR 2,750 is a fixed total for Portuguese institutions regardless of what the university charges, and abroad the ceiling is EUR 8,000 per year, so private-institution fees beyond those figures must be self-funded. Voluntary Social Security contributions above the first bracket, any relocation or housing costs beyond the one-off EUR 1,000 installation allowance, and conference expenses beyond the EUR 750 meeting payment are also out of pocket.
document_audit: Foreign degrees: recognition must be requested on the DGES platform and the proof submitted; FCT publicly warned that recognition timescales are fixed by law and widely known, and did not accept late issuing as a candidate's excuse in general terms
Tuition is paid only to the institution that awards the degree - an invoice from a host lab, research unit or secondment institution that is not the degree granter will not be settled

For foreign tuition already paid out of pocket, reimbursement normally requires an original paper receipt dated and stamped by the paying institution, although FCT currently accepts digital copies as an exception
Scholarship components can only be transferred to an IBAN held with a Portuguese institution (starting PT50), so non-residents need a Portuguese account

Since the 2025 call, contracts are signed with the Contracting Institution rather than FCT, so the accident-insurance cover you actually receive is whatever that institution puts in place - ask for the policy details before accepting
alerts: The 2026 cycle closed on 31 March 2026 at 17:00 Lisbon time; provisional results were published on 31 July 2026 and final results were expected at the beginning of November 2026
FCT publishes no dates for the next cycle in advance - the Expected Calls page is empty - so the practical planning assumption is a March window with an announcement in late February
The 10-working-day validation window (6 to 17 April 2026 in the last cycle) runs after submission and is the most common silent failure point
The preliminary hearing is only 10 working days from the provisional decision and must be filed through myFCT, so keep the login and notifications accessible
A separate non-academic line of the same call funds plans run mainly outside academic institutions; check which line your plan fits before applying, as each has its own page and rules
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Sign in to myFCT, open the regular line of application, complete the form naming the Contracting Institution, upload the RBI and Notice documents before the closing time, then actively chase that institution to validate the file within 10 working days before panels begin.
